text: Muzzle flash, tracer and the aim sight line start at the animated muzzle (1142, 1472), but bullets come from playerFireOrigin() (1472): v2 keeps that split, with the server deciding hits from the sim origin. Exception the legacy header (225-226) does not mention: the muzzle is a child of the posed gun (shamble-core.js:696-697), and grenade and molotov launch points plus the arc preview come from getMuzzle(player) (1406 throwMolotov, 1760 throwGrenadeCharged, 1733 arc preview), so the animated pose, including the throw wind-up tilt at 385, moves where a thrown grenade starts. In v2 the sim must pick the throw origin.
The draw lift and bayonet thrust came with the actions pass that ROADMAP.md:70 lists as 'built, awaiting Brave check'; the core hold and hand IK is Brave-confirmed (ROADMAP.md:44).
